guardrails: A bounded Phase 6 acceptance remains accepted and is not reopened by continuation work.
No continuation item blocks Phase 7 by default.
Candidate-only outputs remain candidate-only until their own acceptance gate passes.
A merged PR or successful workflow does not automatically mark a semantic capability accepted.
Phase 6 data consumed by Phase 7 must pass through a versioned adapter that preserves provenance and candidate state.
Naturalistic, synthetic, controlled, and operational evaluation populations remain separate.

work_items.title: Productive coordination beyond the registered shared-argument profile
work_items.objective: Expand coordinated predicates, shared arguments, coordination scope, and multi-conjunct composition beyond the narrow registered profile.
work_items.acceptance_gate: Per-language positive, negative, ambiguous, and boundary cases; exact source spans; correct shared and non-shared argument bindings; zero false unique outputs; protected Phase 1–5 and bounded Phase 6 regressions.
work_items.notes: The accepted shared-subject/predicate/patient profile remains accepted; this item covers broader patterns only.

work_items.title: Broader embedded, subordinate, relative, and argument-gap attachment
work_items.objective: Expand attachment and composition for complements, relative clauses, conditionals, temporal clauses, and argument gaps.
work_items.acceptance_gate: Per-language construction-specific fixtures with attachment alternatives, exact marker/clause spans, negative abstention, ambiguity preservation, and cycle/reference validation.
work_items.notes: The registered causal and causal/temporal ambiguity profiles remain accepted; broader attachment is separate.

work_items.title: Active/passive alternations and speech acts beyond passive questions
work_items.objective: Extend voice and communicative-form handling to active/passive alternations, imperatives, commands, requests, and other separately defined speech-act forms.
work_items.acceptance_gate: Per-language minimal pairs and adversarial cases distinguish grammatical voice, semantic roles, and speech-act force; exact spans and ambiguity/abstention gates pass.
work_items.notes: The registered passive-question profile remains accepted.

work_items.title: Broader nested operator and quantifier scope
work_items.objective: Expand nested negation, modality, quantifier, conditional, and cross-construction operator scope.
work_items.acceptance_gate: Minimal-pair and scope-contrast sets per language; explicit target/operand structure; alternatives for ambiguous scope; no sentence-wide or keyword-only shortcuts.
work_items.notes: Current registered modality/negation and nested-scope ambiguity profiles remain accepted; broader scope remains open.

work_items.title: Discourse-reference candidate expansion and conservative resolution research
work_items.objective: Improve mention linking, candidate retrieval, discourse salience evidence, and conservative reference decisions without equating similarity with identity.
work_items.acceptance_gate: Per-language multi-antecedent and no-antecedent cases; explicit contextual evidence; identity decisions only under separately defined evidence thresholds; otherwise preserve unresolved alternatives.
work_items.notes: Candidate preservation is accepted for registered profiles; unique real-world identity resolution remains disabled.

work_items.title: Canonical semantic-assertion projection beyond OPAQUE preservation
work_items.objective: Investigate safe mappings from candidate graph structures to canonical USG-SEM/1.0 assertions where the existing contract can represent every required meaning without loss.
work_items.acceptance_gate: Explicit per-relation mapping contract; round-trip and loss-detection tests; source and derivation completeness; reject any unmapped or unsupported semantics; no USG-SEM/1.0 schema mutation.
work_items.notes: OPAQUE preservation remains accepted; semantic-assertion projection is not accepted.

work_items.title: Rights-cleared naturalistic evaluation for Phase 6 constructions
work_items.objective: Build separately reported evaluation populations for realistic English and MSA Arabic text without relying on the synthetic acceptance suite as naturalistic gold.
work_items.acceptance_gate: Source license/rights and privacy review; provenance and deduplication manifest; explicit annotation/reference quality and population limits; per-language/per-construction reporting; no invented semantic labels.
work_items.notes: Naturalistic semantic accuracy is not established by the current graph-first synthetic suite.

work_items.title: Construction-level runtime enablement and candidate promotion decisions
work_items.objective: Evaluate candidate construction profiles for any separately justified runtime enablement without changing the bounded accepted baseline.
work_items.acceptance_gate: A construction can be enabled only after its own per-language quality, ambiguity, abstention, provenance, compatibility, and independent-evidence requirements are met; report all decisions and non-claims.
work_items.notes: No tracker status or merged PR by itself authorizes runtime promotion.
